COVAL.verified_scope: Primary PDF pages 1, 2, 6 and 9 exposed by the search index; full PDF download returned HTTP 403/429, so not a verified local full text.
COVAL.training: Synthetic factual/counterfactual visibility interventions, segmentation, missing-region reconstruction and representation consistency. Pretraining uses SemanticKITTI, Panoptic-CUDAL and STU inlier data.
COVAL.inference: One factual LiDAR scan; counterfactual construction is training-only.
COVAL.author_failure_analysis: Page 9: weaker benefit for very small, low-height and far-range anomalies, which yield few returns and weak visibility changes; sequence 142 is an example.
COVAL.difference_from_current_method: Our tested change is an original-return relation conditioned on the query position. Our two training views use independent detection losses, without COVAL reconstruction or cross-view consistency.
COVAL.prediction_gap: No author code, checkpoint or per-point prediction release was located in the checked paper and author/conference pages; no same-panel COVAL result is available.

reported_reference.verification: Primary PDF text exposed by search index on 2026-09-17; direct PDF returned browser verification, so no local PDF is claimed.
reported_reference.comparison_limit: Literature reference, not a local matched prediction baseline; backbone and pretraining differ from D3.

LIDO.verified_scope: Downloaded publisher PDFs; verified PDF headers and extracted text.
LIDO.information: XYZI, MinkowskiNet, semantic and contrastive heads, class prototypes, feature distributions; combines both heads at inference. STU model trains on SemanticKITTI.
LIDO.author_limits: Section 5.2 discusses class imbalance, semantic uncertainty, similar surfaces and sparse distant points; supplement Table 14 gives STU range-specific AP.
LIDO.difference_from_current_method: LIDO constrains semantic feature distributions; our experiment isolates conditional local raw-return relations with one anomaly logit.
LIDO.prediction_gap: Official pretrained models exist, but no verified predictions are available in this workspace. TorchSparse is absent; model release alone is not a baseline result.

REL.verified_scope: Author full-text HTML and downloaded PDF, verified header and content type; sections 3.2 and 5.5 read.
REL.information: Mask4Former3D plus a pointwise branch using the difference between positive-class and surrogate-negative energies; Point Raise provides synthetic outliers.
REL.author_limits: Section 5.5: complex high-curvature surfaces and boundaries remain difficult under shape discontinuities and sparse sampling.
REL.difference_from_current_method: REL changes scoring and supervision, rather than adding our conditional local relation operator.

independent_test.availability: Public scans and author-mediated hidden-label evaluation. Official README update dated 2025-11-12 asks for a downloadable prediction link.
independent_test.local_status: Only remote ZIP directory inspected; no test scans downloaded, used for tuning, or evaluated.
independent_test.submission_status: No author contacted and no predictions submitted.

comparison_limits: Literature descriptions are not replicated baseline results.
Do not use V1/V2 results as evidence of COVAL failure.
Real physical height and occlusion counterfactual annotations remain unavailable.
